title: 3d snake need a multiplayer test
author: ShoppingOdd9657
selftext:
Hey Reddit, I need your help.

I’m working on a multiplayer mode for my [3D Snake](https://snake.brdlb.com/) game, and I’m looking for a few people to help me test it.

Right now I mainly need to figure out matchmaking, see how the game behaves with real players, and collect feedback on bugs or anything that feels broken or confusing.

comments.author: jaykrown
comments.body: Being able to change your view orientation is disorienting. Changing what is "up" or "down" like that. I think if you made it happen instantly it wouldn't be so bad? I think how it happens suddenly and then smoothly just makes it feel bad.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: It feels bad when you’re watching someone else move. It’s much better when you’re doing it yourself — then your brain is ready for it.

replies.author: NaturalWorking8782
replies.body: Thats how motion sickness works for driving a car, not for this camera that is a spinning and twisting unpredictably.

replies.author: LucidFir
replies.body: did you playtest it or are you commenting after only watching the video?

replies.author: NaturalWorking8782
replies.body: I was trying to help you better understand the motion sickness issue, but it feels like you’ve already decided you know what players want instead of being open to criticism.

replies.author: LucidFir
replies.body: am I op? lmao

replies.author: NaturalWorking8782
replies.body: responded from email, the defensiveness you wrote made me think you were op

replies.author: LucidFir
replies.body:
text is hard. we all read things with a stupid amount of bias. there was definitely some defensiveness in my comment, but it would have served us both better for you to assume the best. 

i think you can't know if OP is wrong about their assertion, that the game isn't sickening when you actually play it, without playing it yourself. 

that's all i meant. did you play it? if not, how can you be so sure OP is wrong that it's only sickening second hand. 

i definitely agree it's nauseating as a video lol

replies.author: jaykrown
replies.body: I just played, and no, it's not much better doing it myself. Also all I want is to be able to move up and down without having to change my entire perspective. Really annoying to play.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body: It's looking good keep it up

comments.author: _kony2012
comments.body: I think what's confusing me the most (besides letters instead of arrows) is that Q controls the environment/world rather than the snake itself. I'm confused enough by it I might be wrong by this, but that's what it seems like to me is that you're spinning the box rather than making the worm itself go up/down.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: It’s not the world around you that changes. It’s the way you see the world.

replies.author: _kony2012
replies.body: That’s not how it appears

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: Does the world spin around you when you lie down in bed?

replies.author: _kony2012
replies.body: I think I've been polite and generous in giving feedback that you specifically requested.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: Fair point. I got defensive there. What you’re describing is a visual feedback problem, and that’s useful feedback

comments.author: Hanzimer
comments.body: I think this game should be used for testing Nasa pilots. If you can play this game for more than 30 seconds without puking, you can be an astronaut.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: A vomit bag will be included with every physical copy of the game.

comments.author: Kalaminator
comments.body: I like it! This is much better than the 3D free movement to keep track of space and collision. I like the concept. Will see if I can try it.

comments.author: Nozx
comments.body:
Love it, the 3d movement is peak innovation that a lot of games shy away from.

It takes some learning to get the hang of it but I DONT think you should nerf it or make it "easier", that's the whole skill piece of it.

If you're going for mass appeal you might have to, the masses are ......they dont like change or new.

But if you're trying to stick to your vision, keep it as is imo.

Throw in some catchy sound effects and you're gold.

IDK if you plan to monetize this, but personally I wouldn't pay more than $5-$10 if that. Its a cool arcade style game, I May not be the exact target audience so IDK?

maybe something like Pay $1 to add a custom texture?

replies.body: I use it just for translation to be sure sure I’ve chosen the right phrasing.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657

This is eerily similar. Though my muscle memory keeps making me change the FOV all the time :)

It constantly feels like you joined the game at the end of a party — bodies lying around everywhere, piled on top of each other.

The speed boost is a cool idea. And honestly, just spectating the bots is surprisingly pleasant.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body:
I was having similar issues playing yours at first wanting to use w/s. They are very similar, and I have a snake mode planned for later. 

Some of the other game modes will restart the entire arena so you don't feel immediately cramped every time. 

I put a lot of view options in just because I enjoyed watching the bots just do there thing. I like setting it to maximum bots on the largest cube and just letting them go. 

I truly do appreciate the feedback. Thank you.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: Maybe have the camera be closer to the tip, to give a higher sense of control

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body: Go to settings

comments.author: StoicBountyHunter
comments.body:
The game design is poor like most of AI games out there, did you even think about the safe area in a 3D space?

​On a 20x20 2D grid, there are 400 cells. A snake length of 50 occupies 12.5% of the world.

​On a 20 x 20 x 20 3D grid, there are 8,000 cells. A snake length of 50 occupies just 0.625% of the world.

Just the base idea is poor, have fun balancing that.

replies.author: ShoppingOdd9657
replies.body:
The game was made 15 years ago, which, of course, doesn't change the fact that the game design really is pretty poor. It was only my second attempt at game development.

I recently dusted off the old concept and brought it back to life with AI. And yeah, one of the first things I realized was that filling the entire 3D space with the snake is actually pretty difficult — but that's not really the goal for me.

Could you explain what you mean by the "safe area" in 3D space?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
the issue with your game is that it is pretty hard to count the "squares" (cubes in your game but typically squares)

part of the fun of snake is being able to make very precise movements quickly

also, I feel like the player would be pretty much losing once they go fast enough for the camera angle to turn against them.
